# mxroute_email_account (Data Source)

Look up a mailbox case-insensitively using a complete list then canonical detail read. Ambiguous matches fail. No password can be read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_email_account" "support" {
  domain   = "example.com"
  username = "support"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Owned canonical domain.
- `username` (String) Mailbox local part; case-insensitive lookup.

### Read-Only

- `canonical_username` (String) Server canonical mailbox local part.
- `email` (String) Mailbox email address.
- `limit` (Number) Daily send limit.
- `quota` (Number) Storage quota in MB; zero means unlimited.
- `sent` (Number) Volatile daily sent count.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Server-reported suspension status.
- `usage` (Number) Volatile storage usage in MB.
